# Contributing to Supervision 🛠️

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Supervision! Please read and follow our [Code of Conduct](../docs/code_of_conduct.md).

> ⚠️ **You must sign the Contributor License Agreement (CLA).** The `cla-assistant` bot asks you to sign it when you open your first pull request, and we can only review and merge pull requests from contributors who have signed.

> 💡 **Contribute from a personal fork.** GitHub does not let maintainers push to a pull request branch that lives in an organization-owned fork, so we could not fix a small issue or rebase for you. Keep **Allow edits by maintainers** enabled on your pull request.

The full contributing guide lives in the documentation:

- [Contributing overview](../docs/contributing/index.md): what we welcome and how we decide on new features.
- [Your first contribution](../docs/contributing/first_contribution.md): fork, branch, commit and open a pull request.
- [Development guide](../docs/contributing/development.md): environment setup, API design principles, code style, tests, documentation and deprecations.
- [AI-assisted contributions](../docs/contributing/ai_assisted.md): how to set up and work with an AI coding assistant.

By contributing, you agree that your contributions will be licensed under the [MIT license](../LICENSE.md).
